subject: Build only libsearch when running integration tests (#1691)
reason: The change touches only the build system: build.sh now sets CMAKE_TARGET=libsearch when running integration tests without unit tests, and vmsdk/CMakeLists.txt gates the testing subdirectory behind BUILD_UNIT_TESTS. No module source code, command handling, indexing, or runtime behaviour changes — the produced libsearch module is identical, so there is nothing a runtime scenario could exercise.
